items.source: All official starters follow a similar naming pattern; spring-boot-starter-*, where * is a particular type of application. This naming structure is intended to help when you need to find a starter. The Maven integration in many IDEs lets you search dependencies by name. For example, with the appropriate Eclipse or Spring Tools plugin installed, you can press ctrl-space in the POM editor and type “spring-boot-starter” for a complete list.
items.translation: 所有官方启动器都遵循相似的命名模式：spring-boot-starter-*，其中*代表特定类型的应用程序。这种命名结构旨在帮助您查找所需的启动器。许多 IDE 中的 Maven 集成允许您按名称搜索依赖项。例如，安装了相应的 Eclipse 或 Spring Tools 插件后，您可以在 POM 编辑器中按下 ctrl-space 并输入“spring-boot-starter”以获取完整列表。

items.source: As explained in the Creating Your Own Starter section, third party starters should not start with spring-boot, as it is reserved for official Spring Boot artifacts. Rather, a third-party starter typically starts with the name of the project. For example, a third-party starter project called thirdpartyproject would typically be named thirdpartyproject-spring-boot-starter.
items.translation: 正如创建自己的 Starter部分中所解释的，第三方 Starter 不应以spring-boot开头，因为该名称保留给官方的 Spring Boot 构件。相反，第三方 Starter 通常以项目名称开头。例如，一个名为thirdpartyproject的第三方 Starter 项目通常命名为thirdpartyproject-spring-boot-starter。

items.source: The curated list contains all the Spring modules that you can use with Spring Boot as well as a refined list of third party libraries. The list is available as a standard Bills of Materials (spring-boot-dependencies) that can be used with both Maven and Gradle.
items.translation: 精选列表包含了所有可与 Spring Boot 一起使用的 Spring 模块，以及经过筛选的第三方库列表。该列表以标准的物料清单（spring-boot-dependencies）形式提供，既可用于 Maven，也可用于 Gradle。

items.source: It is strongly recommended that you choose a build system that supports dependency management and that can consume artifacts published to the Maven Central repository. We would recommend that you choose Maven or Gradle. It is possible to get Spring Boot to work with other build systems (Ant, for example), but they are not particularly well supported.
items.translation: 强烈建议您选择一个支持依赖管理并能消费发布到 Maven Central 仓库的构建工具。 我们推荐使用 Maven 或 Gradle。 虽然可以让 Spring Boot 与其他构建工具（例如 Ant）配合工作，但它们的支持并不完善。

items.source: It is possible to build a Spring Boot project using Apache Ant+Ivy. The spring-boot-antlib “AntLib” module is also available to help Ant create executable jars.
items.translation: 可以使用 Apache Ant+Ivy 构建 Spring Boot 项目。`spring-boot-antlib`“AntLib”模块也可用于帮助 Ant 创建可执行的 jar 包。

items.source: Starters are a set of convenient dependency descriptors that you can include in your application. You get a one-stop shop for all the Spring and related technologies that you need without having to hunt through sample code and copy-paste loads of dependency descriptors. For example, if you want to get started using Spring and JPA for database access, include the spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency in your project.
items.translation: 启动器是一组便捷的依赖描述符，您可以将其包含在应用程序中。您无需通过示例代码搜寻并复制粘贴大量依赖描述符，即可一站式获取所需的所有 Spring 及相关技术。例如，如果您想开始使用 Spring 和 JPA 进行数据库访问，请在项目中包含 spring-boot-starter-data-jpa 依赖。

items.source:
Each release of Spring Boot provides a curated list of dependencies that it supports.
In practice, you do not need to provide a version for any of these dependencies in your build configuration, as Spring Boot manages that for you.
When you upgrade Spring Boot itself, these dependencies are upgraded as well in a consistent way.
items.translation: Spring Boot 的每个发行版都提供一份经过精选的支持依赖列表。在实际操作中，您无需在构建配置中为这些依赖指定版本，因为 Spring Boot 会为您进行管理。当您升级 Spring Boot 本身时，这些依赖也会以一致的方式得到升级。
